# Complaint triage taxonomy for the Bank.
# Each complaint receives exactly one product and one issue from this file.

version: 3
products:
  - product: Checking/Savings
    issues:
      - Account opening or closing
      - Deposits and withdrawals
      - Overdraft or NSF fees
      - Transfers and automatic payments
      - Account access or frozen funds

  - product: Credit card
    issues:
      - Billing dispute
      - Unauthorized charge
      - Fees or interest
      - Credit limit change
      - Rewards

  - product: Mortgage
    issues:
      - Payment processing or escrow
      - Late fees
      - Loan modification or forbearance
      - Servicing transfer
      - Closing costs

  - product: Auto loan
    issues:
      - Payment problem
      - Repossession
      - Add-on products or GAP coverage
      - Payoff or title release

  - product: Personal loan
    issues:
      - Application or denial
      - Payment problem
      - Fees or interest
      - Payoff

  - product: Debt collection
    issues:
      - Debt not owed
      - Communication tactics
      - Validation or verification
      - Credit reporting of collected debt

  - product: Other/escalate
    issues:
      - Needs human review

complaint_id,date_received,channel,narrative
C-1301,2026-09-15,Web,"I asked for a credit limit increase to $10,000 in the app and it said approved on September 2. The next day my limit was back to $5,000 and my card was declined at the vet while my dog was in surgery. Nobody can explain what happened."
C-1302,2026-09-16,Phone,I have a recurring $500 transfer from checking to savings every Friday. On September 12 it ran three times in the same day and overdrew my checking. I had to move money back myself and my rent check almost bounced.
C-1303,2026-09-17,Mail,I applied for a loan modification in June and sent every document they asked for. Every 30 days I get a letter saying my application is incomplete and asking for the same pay stubs again. I've sent them four times now.
C-1304,2026-09-18,Email,"A collector is trying to collect $2,045 and will not tell me who the original creditor is, only that it was a Bank account. I asked in writing on August 20 for the name of the creditor and an itemization. No answer."
C-1305,2026-09-19,Web,"My personal loan payment is on autopay. In August the Bank changed the payment date without telling me and the payment came out four days early, before my paycheck landed, so my checking went negative. I want the date set back to the 20th."
All five map cleanly and none meet the flag criteria. I'll put the labels and the write step in a script you can reuse for the backfill.

args.content:
import sys

import pandas as pd

BATCH = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "fixtures/batches/batch_13.csv"
COLUMNS = ["complaint_id", "product", "issue", "udaap_flag", "fair_lending_flag", "evidence"]

LABELS = {
    'C-1301': ('Credit card', 'Credit limit change', 'N', 'N', ''),
    'C-1302': ('Checking/Savings', 'Transfers and automatic payments', 'N', 'N', ''),
    'C-1303': ('Mortgage', 'Loan modification or forbearance', 'N', 'N', ''),
    'C-1304': ('Debt collection', 'Validation or verification', 'N', 'N', ''),
    'C-1305': ('Personal loan', 'Payment problem', 'N', 'N', ''),
}

df = pd.read_csv(BATCH)
out = pd.DataFrame([(cid, *LABELS[cid]) for cid in df["complaint_id"]], columns=COLUMNS)
print(f"Triaged {len(out)} of {len(df)} complaints")
out.to_csv("outputs/triage_output.csv", index=False)
print("Wrote outputs/triage_output.csv")
